text:
lee_sales: Starting RFI thread for Lydon Health. They requested a 3-week POC (Private VPC + optional on-prem HSM), capability matrix, and tiered pricing for embeddings + streaming. Also asked for a security questionnaire and an example SOW.

arun_se: I can take the capmatrix and written answers. Quick Q: embeddings target is 60 QPS sustained — do we recommend Dedicated or Reserved?

megan_infra: For 60 QPS embeddings, Reserved Dedicated (3xA10) should hit it with batching + KV cache. On-prem HSM supported (Thales/CloudHSM). We can provide SOC2 and ISO certs under NDA; FedRAMP is a status doc only.

arun_se: Thanks. Draft capmatrix snippet (will upload spreadsheet later):

"Feature | Redwood Response | Notes
Private VPC | Supported | Customer-managed peering
On-prem HSM | PKCS#11 + CloudHSM | Thales, AWS CloudHSM supported
Dedicated POC | Reserved GPU pools | Autoscale & burst options
Embeddings throughput | 60 QPS achievable | ~3xA10, batching, KV cache
Streaming | Supported, chunked streams | Token-level latency controls
Compliance | SOC2, ISO27001 (NDA) | FedRAMP: in-progress note"

megan_infra: Uploaded attestation placeholder: lydon_hsm_note.txt -> https://redwood.docs/attachments/1746001234/lydon_hsm_note.txt

tasha_prod: For pricing: propose POC 4-week reserved at 45% off list, includes 10 hours onboarding support. Production: tiered per-embed pricing with volume discounts and streaming per-token rates. I'll draft SOW with milestones and acceptance criteria (embedding recall threshold + latency).

lee_sales: Legal wants KMS flow diagram and sample NDAs wording for cert artifacts. Can infra attach KMS flow and confirm we never persist plaintext customer keys?

megan_infra: Confirmed: customer keys -> customer KMS/HSM -> Redwood Private (we do not persist plaintext keys). Uploaded KMS flow: lydon_kms_flow.png -> https://redwood.docs/attachments/1746001234/lydon_kms_flow.png

arun_se: I'll flag an optional int8 quant path in the capmatrix to show cost reduction options.

ndc-bot: File uploaded by tasha_prod: lydon_pricing_onepager.pdf -> https://redwood.docs/attachments/1746001234/lydon_pricing_onepager.pdf

lee_sales: Actions: (1) @arun_se finalize capmatrix + narrative by EOD, (2) @megan_infra attach cert IDs and formal attestation under NDA, (3) @tasha_prod finalize pricing + SOW. Target: send draft RFI to Lydon tomorrow morning.

megan_infra: Cert refs: SOC2-2024-RED-008 (NDA), ISO-RED-1140. Will upload attestation under NDA when legal greenlight.

lee_sales: Great. If they push FedRAMP evidence, we'll escalate to GRC. Thanks team, will assemble package once items are in. End.
